title: Charging gates.
officialText: Charging gates, when provided, shall be power operated. Gates and guide rails shall be of such materials and construction so as to withstand a temperature of two thousand degrees Fahrenheit without distortion, warping, binding, cracking, or corrosion, and also to withstand impact by heavy falling objects.
